title: State relabeling of reading actions
statement: Let $r,s$ be work-tape indices, let $st$ map reading phases to states, and let $ex$ map optional Boolean values to states. For every reading phase $ph$, optional Boolean value $a$, and tuple $w$ of symbols under the work-tape heads, mapping the states of the reading transition defined using the two canonical inclusions into a sum type by the function that applies $st$ on the left summand and $ex$ on the right gives exactly the reading transition defined directly using $st$ and $ex$.
hypotheses_covered: A state map $st$ from reading phases
A state map $ex$ from optional Boolean values
An arbitrary tuple $w$ of optional Boolean symbols
